note: Act 1 quests the log can show. Ids are the task layer's (internal/task/world.go); stage names are the task layer's (started, cleared, done). reward is per difficulty (S: from the plan note quest-points.json for Den, from the wiki for the others, U: nightmare and hell not checked); a difficulty with no entry shows no reward line. Text names no monster or place the hero has not been sent to by that quest.

started.objective: Clear the Den of Evil, the cave north of the Blood Moor.
started.why: Akara asked the hero to kill every monster in the cave before the camp is overrun.

cleared.why: The Den is empty. Akara pays when the hero reports back.

done.why: The hero spoke to Akara and the quest is closed.

started.objective: Kill Blood Raven at the Burial Grounds.
started.why: Kashya asked the hero to free her old Rogue sister from the curse that raised her.

cleared.why: Blood Raven is dead. Kashya waits to hear it.

done.objective: Done. Kashya's rogues will hire out.
done.why: Kashya thanked the hero and offers mercenaries.

started.objective: Find the Horadric Malus in the Barracks.
started.why: Charsi needs her lost hammer, the Horadric Malus, and sent the hero to the Barracks.

cleared.why: The hero holds the Malus. Charsi will use it.

done.objective: Done. Charsi can imbue an item.
done.why: Charsi repaid the favour with a crafting service.

started.objective: Find the Scroll of Inifuss and read it with Akara.
started.why: Akara thinks Deckard Cain is alive and the scroll in the Dark Wood points to where.

cleared.why: The scroll is read. The trail leads to the Cairn Stones.

done.why: Cain was rescued in Tristram and is back in camp.

started.objective: Kill the Countess at the Forgotten Tower.
started.why: The way to the lower levels runs through the Forgotten Tower and its mistress.

done.why: The place is quiet at last.

started.why: The last guard of the way east is the Maiden of Anguish.

cleared.why: Andariel is dead. The road east is open.

done.why: The hero can sail east to Lut Gholein.
